description: The products What's New tracks release notes for, with slugs, categories and platforms. Filter by category and/or a name query.

category.description: Limit results to one product category.

sort.description: "popular" ranks by current audience popularity — outside signals (stars, downloads, players) blended with this site's own readers — and answers "what are the most popular software right now?". Default is the curated catalog order (or search relevance when query is set, which ignores sort).

name: list_products

archived.description: Whether the upstream repository is archived; absent when unknown.

labels.description: Provenance to keep with any quote, e.g. “Sample data”.

license.description: SPDX expression as the product's own source states it, e.g. MIT or LicenseRef-proprietary; absent when unknown.

url.description: This product's page on What's New.

title: List tracked products
